# `base/typography`

Rendering library-owned copy in a role — heading, body, label, link or sanitized rich text.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Rendering library-owned copy in a role — heading, body, label, link or sanitized rich text.
- **Avoid when:** The text is a formatted data value rather than prose.
- **Consider instead:** `primitives`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { DisplayLabel } from "themelia-ui/base/typography"
import "themelia-ui/base/typography.css"
```

## Composition

This family has no component-family dependencies.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `DisplayLabel`

Kind: callable.

**Use when:** A read-only label or group name.

**Avoid when:** Labeling an editable control.

**Compose:** Pass plain content, without nested Text or local font overrides.

**Capabilities:** readonly labels; metadata typography.

**Alternatives:** FormField, MetadataList.

```text
({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"span">) => React.JSX.Element
```

### `Text`

Kind: const.

**Use when:** Primary copy and supporting text with a stable reusable typography role.

**Avoid when:** A field label, surface title or metadata label whose owner already styles it.

**Compose:** Leave ordinary body size unset to inherit provider defaults; use xs for genuine support copy.

**Capabilities:** body copy typography; supporting text.

**Alternatives:** DisplayLabel, Heading.

```text
React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<TextProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLElement>>
```

### `TextLinkProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `React.ComponentProps<"a">`, `VariantProps<typeof linkVariants>`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |

### `TextProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "children">`, `Pick<Partial<React.LabelHTMLAttributes<HTMLLabelElement>>, "htmlFor">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `content` | no | `string` | Text as a plain string. Equivalent to passing it as `children`. |
| `type` | no | `TextType` | Semantic role, which selects the colour token. `main` for primary copy, `secondary`<br>for supporting copy (descriptions, captions, metadata); `inherit` takes the parent's. |
| `size` | no | `TextSize` | Step on the type scale. Omit it on primary content so the Typography provider<br>default flows; reserve `xs` for support text and metadata. |
| `align` | no | `TextAlign` | Horizontal alignment. |
| `lineHeight` | no | `TextLineHeight` | Leading, on the shared tier. `tight` and `none` suit dense rows and single-line<br>values; `relaxed` suits prose. |
| `numeric` | no | `boolean` | Tabular figures, so digits align in a column. Use for any value in a table. |
| `truncate` | no | `boolean` | Ellipsises the text at one line. Makes the element a block with `min-width: 0`;<br>every flex box between it and the constrained width also needs `min-width: 0`<br>(`Stack` and `Grid` set it; a hand-rolled flex div does not). |
| `weight` | no | `TextWeight` | Font weight. |
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` | Text content. Takes precedence over `content`. |
| `tag` | no | `"div" \| "p" \| "span" \| "label"` | Element to render: `span` inline, `p` for prose, `div` when it wraps blocks, `label`<br>for a form label. For headings use `Heading`. |
